report_notes: reproduction.json: three unchanged-runtime assertion failures before runtime edits: next question cleared, unrelated late wait consumed, and stale session finalized after runner ownership transfer.
focused.json: initial three fixes plus existing question/hand-off paths, 20 passed across four files. Historical intermediate-source evidence, overlapping later full run.

uncertainty-reproduction.json: two selected tests failed before changing non-delivery reporting, both before and after fake delivery. Ten skipped cases were excluded by the test-name filter, not disabled failing tests or conditional acceptance skips.
expanded-focused.json: 59 passed, one fixture timeout because it compared database JobStatus with API COMPLETED rather than DONE. Runtime unchanged for correction.

fleet-targeted.json: 246 passed, 18 fixture assertions failed because API mirroring was read immediately after database DONE and was still ACKNOWLEDGED. The corrected fixture waits for BOTH database DONE and API COMPLETED, with the same timeout and assertions plus consumed-wait checks.

corrected-targeted.json: 264 passed across 24 files on the final runtime/test sources; includes 216 new cases and existing Pay result/question plus Ledger/Marketing bus regressions. Overlaps the full run, not additive.

No runtime change followed the expanded focused run; only terminal-result fixture state/mirror synchronization changed. 21 changed runtime/test source hashes were frozen after the corrected targeted run and before complete regression.

local_checks.completion_gate: expected exit 1; every app still 15 partial and 3 pending groups

limitations: Initial answer driven through the real gate with a synthetic locally acquired runner claim, fake Matrix/model and seeded outgoing receiver state. Follow-on questions/results use a fresh assistant. Fixture-only tasks.open target; shipping manifests unchanged.
Preparation, send and finalization remain separate. No durable immutable outbound intent, idempotent wait reuse or automatic repair of prepared pending waits after crash/final-step rollback.

Changed-answer retries and concurrent sends are not content-bound by the gate; model-facing uncertainty guidance is not enforcement. The tool still lacks expected peer wait identity, leaving question changes before preparation unbound.
An in-flight send can reach the peer after cancellation/ownership change; ownership checks cannot undo transport effects and are not a new wall-clock lease guarantee.

No generic hand-off/all-gate session-fencing claim. Live-job deadlines/late results, mixed-wait expiry, generic dependencies, early questions before root persistence and other ingress atomicity remain open.
Historical eager/partial receipts and privacy/retention-safe deduplication require audited designs. Previous Pay approval wake-count and Ledger presence intermittent failures remain unexplained.
Coordinate drained old answer senders/question/result receivers plus t023/input-expiry worker rollout; mixed-version compatibility unverified. Refresh current-source artifacts before release.

Owner policies for eligible/elevated roles, amount/currency limits, self-approval and historical/nonhuman handling remain missing. Business workflows, provider/source parity, privacy/legacy conversion, production restore/DBA and live Matrix/model/NEOS UI/provider acceptance remain incomplete.
No push, merge, deployment or real payment/message/signature/access/export/filing.
